VIKAS PEDNEKAR

Head IT | Senior Tech Infrastructure Program Manager | Cybersecurity & Risk Governance Leader +91 7208564975 | vikasspednekar@yahoo.co.in. | Mumbai | www.LinkedIn.com/vikasspednekar

PROFESSIONAL OVERVIEW

Strategic Senior IT Infrastructure & Technical Program Manager with over 23 years of experience driving enterprise-scale transformation across Banking, Pharmaceuticals, and IT Services. Proven expertise in leading complex global programs spanning cloud, datacenter migration/optimization, infrastructure modernization, and database transformation across Windows/Linux environments.

Strong focus on cybersecurity governance, IT risk management, and regulatory compliance, with hands-on experience in RCSA, ITGC

controls, and control testing aligned to frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, and NFR.

Demonstrated success in delivering multi-million-dollar programs, achieving 99.9% system availability, and driving significant cost

optimization and operational efficiency.

Recognized for thriving in high-pressure environments, influencing senior stakeholders, and consistently delivering mission-critical

initiatives on time with strong governance and risk control.

AI-900: Azure AI Fundamentals

Microsoft System Administrator in 2007 -MCP ID: 2832986

AZ-900: Azure Fundamentals

WORK EXPERIENCE

Associate Director – Technical Program Manager

UBS (Union Bank of Switzerland), Mumbai

Jul 2018- June 2026

Achieved measurable outcomes including ~20% cost reduction and improved security and compliance posture, aligning IT delivery with business and regulatory requirements.

Leading and executing US Datacenter consolidation and optimization; with decommissioning of end-of-life application suite, end of life H/W, designing the application infrastructure, Network gateway migration - modernization, Virtualization of physical servers, migration of market connected applications

Driving Digital Transformation and Enterprise Architecture initiatives, achieving ~20% reduction in carbon footprint through

infrastructure optimization and sustainable technology adoption.

Spearheaded enterprise datacenter migration and consolidation (3500+ servers, 260+ applications) for UK region in a regulated

banking environment, enhancing scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency

Executed Active Directory domain consolidation including OU hierarchy redesign, GPO standardization, trust optimization, and

identity governance controls.

Delivered database modernization initiatives including Oracle upgrades (11g–19c), SQL Server/Sybase to PostgreSQL migration • Implemented network transformation from legacy infrastructure to high-speed fiber architecture, optimizing latency, bandwidth, routing, and load balancing Implemented Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions and Privileged Access Management (PAM)

• Led Technology Risk & Compliance activities (1LoD) including ITGC controls, risk assessment, control testing, audit remediation, and regulatory compliance (NFR, COBIT, NIST)

Managed RAID logs (Risk, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), ensuring proactive risk mitigation and delivery governance • Managed vulnerability and security operations using Tanium and Tenable, including patch validation, vulnerability scanning, and remediation tracking

Delivered Data Governance initiatives using Collibra and Informatica, including data quality, metadata management, and data lineage

controls

Developed Power BI / Tableau dashboards for KPI tracking, risk reporting, and executive governance • Leading global teams of 80+ across multi-region delivery environments • Managed global vendor ecosystems including Wipro, Infosys, and OEM partners, delivering large-scale infrastructure, cloud, application, and security programs.

Manager – Project Implementation

Symphony SUMMIT, Mumbai

Aug 2016- Jul 2018

Led West India regional project delivery and managed portfolio of 15+ parallel IT infrastructure programs with full lifecycle



accountability. Implemented robust project governance and risk management frameworks, enhancing execution control, issue resolution, and escalation efficiency.

Achieved 100% on-time project delivery across multiple high-impact initiatives • Collaborated with CxO and senior leadership to ensure alignment with strategic priorities and delivery commitments, consistently achieving 100% on-time execution.

Contributed on Enhancing product quality through cross-functional collaboration with Product and QA teams

Senior Consultant

Capgemini India Pvt. Ltd, Mumbai

Aug 2007- Aug 2016

Current Team Size: 30

Provided technical consulting and solution governance, aligning IT initiatives with business strategy, cost optimization, and enterprise architecture standards • Rolled out enterprise-wide IT infrastructure programs including Exchange migrations, SCCM global deployments, datacenter virtualization, and Blackbox infrastructure rollouts, managing end-to-end lifecycle (solution design, build, migration, and stabilization)

• Delivered high-value transformation initiatives such as Exchange Org Consolidation (€620K), Exchange 2013 Migration with DAG/HA



(€587K), SCCM 2012 Global Deployment (€925K), and Datacenter Virtualization (€750K) across multi-region environments Implemented Messaging-as-a-Service (MaaS) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) platforms, enabling standardized, scalable, and resilient service delivery models

Led solution architecture alignment and technical design, translating business requirements into infrastructure blueprints covering

Active Directory, Exchange, SCCM, virtualization (VMware), and network components

Designed and governed ITIL-based service management frameworks (Incident, Problem, Change, Release), improving operational

stability, SLA compliance, and service maturity

Delivered identity and messaging solutions including Active Directory (multi-domain), ADFS (SSO/federation), Exchange HA/DR



configurations, and SMTP routing optimization Implemented endpoint management architecture using SCCM, enabling automated patching, OS deployment, software distribution, and compliance tracking

Led datacenter consolidation and virtualization programs using VMware, including P2V migrations, capacity planning, and DR

readiness improvements

Provided technical consulting and solution governance, aligning IT initiatives with business strategy, cost optimization, and enterprise architecture standards

PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE Site In-charge

Wipro Infotech Limited, Mumbai

Mar 2005- Aug 2007

ITES Engineer

Anmol Computer, Mumbai

Nov 2004- Mar 2005

Customer Support Engineer

ITSource India Tech Pvt. Ltd, Mumbai

Dec 2002- Nov 2004

KEY PROJECTS (HIGH-VALUE TRANSFORMATIONS) • Datacenter Migration: 3500+ servers, 260+ applications (Banking environment) • Domain Consolidation: Consolidating 32 → 3 Active Directory domains • • • Datacenter Virtualization & Consolidation: €750K • Blackbox Deployment: Virtualizing 400+ different locations (€800K) • Active Directory Federation (ADFS): Secure SSO implementation • Microsoft Lync PoC: Enterprise collaboration evaluation

Exchange Migration & Consolidation: Messaging as A Service €620K+ programs SCCM Global Deployment: Endpoint management across enterprise (€925K)

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS • DH Employee of Month Award (UBS, Oct 2024) – For Automation in business process • •

Fire Fighter (Capgemini, Sep 2014) – For recovering derailed project and finishing it 3 months ahead of schedule Project Star (Capgemini, Jun 2013) – For achieving higher OTACE rate 4.5/5, with high customer satisfaction rating

EDUCATION Bachelor of Engineering | Electronics Engineering | University of Mumbai, 2004

PERSONAL DETAILS Languages Known: English, Hindi, and Marathi Location Preference: Mumbai / Pune
